method: Direct tool image inspection of saved stills and film-frame compositions; four atlas contact sheets cover all 38 peaks, and the airflow contact sheet covers fill/vent/return in four punch types. Full-resolution tall straight, body fill, hook fill and hook vent also inspected.
checked: Whole product remains in frame; fixed head/abdomen target boxes and root/palm references visible in the atlas
Short/mid/tall and partial-extension poses distinguishable; target misses disclosed in numeric packet
Exposed view enlarged after clearing inherited camera-data animation
All U1-U3/F1-F3/T1-T2 labels and isolated-port diagram legible
Cyan differential fill and orange vent visible for hook and body; return-band gold visible during vent/retraction
Paired views correspond to the same source frame; product inset uses aspect-preserving crop and resize
Warning caption and phase strip remain visible on every composed airflow frame
limits: Contact sheets are navigation/QA aids; full-resolution stills are the readable evidence
4 fps films are review previews, not real actuator timing
Image inspection is sampled; full file decoding and frame counts are verified separately
No physical flow, force, retention, strain or collision qualification
